content.text:
All 17 rules are reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations redlined (7)**
- **LOL-CAP** (§21.1): one-month fee cap "without exception" — reset to greater of 12 months' Fees or USD 1M, with §21.3 Excluded Claims restored.
- **INDEMN** (§20): one-way Customer indemnity only — added Vendor IP/law/data-breach/misconduct indemnity and narrowed ours.
- **NONCOMPETE** (§12.4): 24-month post-term, all-territory non-compete — deleted.
- **EXCLUSIVITY** (§2.2): sole-provider exclusivity for the full term with no performance exit — deleted.
- **MINCOMMIT** (§2.1): three-year USD 2M take-or-pay with no exit — deleted, 12-month true-up fallback offered.
- **LICENSE** (§13.1): licence revocable at will, Affiliates/contractors excluded — extended and revocation limited to §13.3.
- **WARRANTY** (§19.2): 15-day conformance with hard cut-off — extended to 90 days with §19.4 remedies.
- **TRANSITION** (§11.1): immediate deletion, no export — replaced with up to six months' transition assistance.

**Compliant (9):** MFN, NOSOLICIT, T4C, RENEWAL, GOVLAW, ASSIGN, IP, AUDIT, LD, INSURANCE — all at or above the preferred position.

Note for negotiation: §12.3 already disclaims exclusivity, non-compete, minimum-volume and no-hire commitments, so §§2.1, 2.2 and 12.4 are internally inconsistent with it; our deletions align the document with §12.3. Also, §9.3 cross-refers to "Section 20.5" remedies that do not exist — worth conforming once the Vendor indemnity is inserted.
